title: Periodic entitlement snapshot service for cross-region residency audits
creator: Ayla Rodriguez
description: Build a service that produces signed, time-bounded entitlement snapshots for tenants across regions to support data residency attestation and periodic access reviews. The service will correlate SSO/SAML session traces, SCIM provisioning deltas, and RBAC role bindings to create a tamper-evident export that can be consumed by auditors and the console evidence pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Service produces a per-tenant snapshot that contains: active user identities, last SSO login timestamp, active SCIM provisioning state, RBAC role bindings, and storage residency tag per principal
2) Snapshots are signed with customer-scoped KMS keys (or platform key when tenant key not configured) and have a verifiable checksum
3) Snapshots can be filtered by region/residency attribute and by time window; exports for a tenant are available via S3 URL with short-lived presigned link
4) Snapshot generation supports incremental mode (SCIM delta) and full mode with consistent pagination to ensure reproducible artifacts for auditors
5) Console shows last snapshot time and a direct link to the audit bundle; automation pushes evidence to the central attestations pipeline
6) End-to-end tests validate a sample tenant with simulated cross-region accounts and SSO sessions; performance goal: generate snapshot for 10k principals in < 10 minutes
7) Security review signoff obtained and threat model updated with KMS and export controls
tasks: Design snapshot schema (fields, residency tags, signatures) and document in Confluence: /confluence/comp-evidence/snapshot-schema
Implement SCIM recon connector that produces delta feed over timeframe and integrates with existing SCIM service
Integrate SSO event store to annotate last-login and active sessions (SAML session trace parsing)
Implement RBAC extractor that flattens role bindings into principal-oriented view
Add KMS signing flow with tenant-key fallback and checksum generation
Wire export pipeline: bundle, sign, store to S3, generate presigned link, record metadata in evidence index
Expose snapshot status in Console and add telemetry/alerts for failures
Create e2e test harness with synthetic tenant and run performance benchmarks
Prepare runbook for on-call: common failure modes and recovery steps
